messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — PayMate (prod) is hitting 429s during the 08:15 UTC spike. They reported ~1.2k RPM and ~20k TPM sustained for ~3m. Customer says they see 0 remaining and Retry-After on responses. Can SRE look? request_id: pay_0xabc123 :eyes:

olivia_engineer: On it. Do we have the X-Rate-Limit headers or tenant-level throttles showing in the logs? Any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026.03.17-3 -> prod completed at 08:10:02 UTC.

eli_sre: Checked logs for token=paymate_01. We hit per-minute token bucket at 08:16:12. Sample server response: 429, body "rate limit exceeded", headers: `x-rate-limit-limit: 1200/min`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 55` (seconds). No global outage.

nia_paymate: Confirmed on our side: a job fan-out kicked off at 08:15 that generated a burst of short requests. Our SDK had 200 concurrent connections. We relied on client retries with fixed 1s backoff which caused retry storms.

olivia_engineer: Two things to do: 1) short-term mitigation - advise PayMate to cap concurrency and implement jittered exponential backoff; 2) collect a request sample for replay. Can you share a small replay (timestamps + endpoints) so we can reproduce locally?

sam_support: I'll request the replay and a pcap-ish curl log. Also asking if we can offer a temporary throughput increase while they fix the client. Any quick suggestions we can give them now?

eli_sre: Quick advice to the customer: reduce concurrent connections to ~40-60, add full jitter backoff (eg. base 200ms, factor 2, max 10s), honour `Retry-After` and `x-rate-limit-reset`. Also enable request folding on their side for identical payloads. If they can move heavy workloads to off-peak windows that helps too.

olivia_engineer: For reproducer, here's a small script they can run to simulate and we can replay from our side — shows how retries amplify: ```bash
for i in $(seq 1 400); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.05
done
wait
```

eli_sre: From infra side: token-level RPM/TPM is enforced by a leaky-bucket per token + a short burst window. We could temporarily raise their per-minute allowance for 1 hour (requires approvals). If this is recurring we should propose Dedicated capacity or an elevated quota with a commit.

nia_paymate: Please escalate for a 1-hour uplift if possible — engineering is patching the client now. We can share the replay within 10m.

sam_support: Filed ticket SUP-8231 requesting a 1-hour uplift and prioritization. Attached: request_id pay_0xabc123, sample timestamps, customer replay to follow.

eli_sre: Noted. Once we get replay, we'll run it against a staging token and capture metric deltas (RPM/TPM + 429 rate). Also check for per-route hot paths — sometimes a high-volume endpoint with small payloads dominates token budget.

olivia_engineer: One more: advise them to look at client batching (combine small prompts) and reuse connections (HTTP keep-alive) to reduce request headcount.

sam_support: I'll send a short mitigation checklist to PayMate now (concurrency cap, jittered backoff, honor Retry-After, replay, consider batching). Keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:
